title: Four Corners
summary: Defeat all four linked guardians in the open-world Four Corners event.
overview: Defeat all four linked guardians in the open-world Four Corners event.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign all four targets before pulling and avoid dropping aggression on a surviving guardian.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Engaging any named enemy places all four on the puller's hate list.
Keep each surviving guardian engaged: ten seconds out of combat resets the group.
Defeating all four spawns the event chest and removes the controller.

notes: Approval E363. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
